added.name: Decisions Fast
added.excerpt: Parallel Decisions Fast is a web-grounded Decisions model: send `state` (text or JSON) plus up to 100 typed `questions` (noul / choice / score) and get structured answers with per-question refusals and request-level citations after live web research — not generated chat text.

added.name: Inkling 2 Small
added.excerpt: Inkling 2 Small is Thinking Machines Lab's second-generation open-weights foundation model: a 594B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts transformer (17B active) with a 1M-token context window, variable reasoning effort, and tool use — aimed at agentic coding, vision, and knowledge work.

added.name: Ampersand v0.1
added.excerpt: Ampersand v0.1 is humans&'s collaborator model, trained from GLM 5.3 for people to achieve goals together: it tracks what each person wants, flags conflicts, shares context, and asks questions in group chats.
